title: Return Text
instructions: Change the return value of main. The compiler should run the task and return the exact text required by the seal.
task: Make main return the text hello, Sley.
misconception: Sley string values are Text values. Keep the quotes around text literals.
expectedBehavior: Running the program returns a Text value.
hints: Look only at the text between quotes.
The return type already says Text, so the returned value must be a text literal.
The final line should return "hello, Sley".

title: First Take
instructions: A task uses take lines to declare explicit inputs. The call site already sends a name, so the task declaration must accept it.
task: Repair greet so main returns hello Ada.
misconception: A take belongs inside the task body, before the return that uses it.
expectedBehavior: Running main calls greet with one Text input.
hints: The diagnostic is about the number of arguments sent to greet.
Add a take named name with type Text inside greet.
Use the input in the return expression: "hello " + name.

title: Mutable Total
instructions: bind is immutable. Accumulators should use a mutable binding kind, usually tally for totals.
task: Repair the binding so main returns 1.
misconception: Do not make every value mutable. Use tally here because the name represents an accumulated total.
expectedBehavior: The program updates total once and returns the updated Int.
hints: The problem is not the set line. The problem is the binding kind.
bind protects the value from mutation.
Replace bind total with tally total.

title: Tally A List
instructions: each walks through a list. The sum task is already complete; main needs to call it with a list of numbers.
task: Complete main so the program returns 10.
misconception: The list literal must contain Int values because sum takes List<Int>.
expectedBehavior: Running main calls sum with a list and returns the accumulated total.
hints: Use a list literal such as [2, 3, 5].
The return can be return call sum([2, 3, 5]).

title: Explain A Diagnostic
instructions: Some trials check whether you can explain the compiler's rule in plain language.
task: Explain why set cannot modify bind total, and name the binding kind you would use for an accumulator.
misconception: The answer is not that Sley forbids updates. Sley forbids updating immutable bindings.
expectedBehavior: A passing answer mentions immutable bind and a mutable accumulator binding such as tally.
starter: The compiler says set cannot modify bind total because ...
hints: Mention that set needs a mutable binding.
Name tally as the accumulator-oriented binding kind.
